summary: Wythe County, VA lookout site on Town of Wytheville land; the register gives two conflicting accounts of the tower's fate, and the site is fenced with an open hiking trail.

facts.status_note: Register gives two conflicting accounts: a communications tower on the lookout's steel frame with the cab removed, or removal and replacement by a Century Link tower. Neither account leaves the lookout cab standing.

access.note: Town property enclosed by fencing; access road closed to motorized traffic; the register says the site is open as a hiking trail

visit.trail_note: Hiking trail open; the register says parking is about two miles below the tower

notes_for_editor: The register gives two conflicting accounts of the tower's fate (converted to a communications tower with the cab and stairs removed, or removed and replaced by a non-original Century Link tower). No source we found settles it. No source gives a build date, builder, or staffing. The microwave license record (Radyn copy, KJH27 path 5) shows a 107.6 ft lattice tower at SAND MTN but shows no date, so it does not show whether that tower is the same one. The register's photo caption 'Foundation to which stairs were mounted' is undated. Elevation: register 3,687 ft; the Roanoker article says 3,721 ft (not used). Brief's status 'gone' and agency kept; access was unknown in the brief and is now set to restricted.
